Coverage and licensing boundary

CFTC COT is a weekly positioning report and can provide reported open interest for covered futures-only markets. It does not provide the exchange daily volume series required for intraday volume profiles, volume delta, or session volume. Those require a separate official exchange feed or a licensed market-data provider. The UI will not substitute prediction-market volume, spot volume or a generic chart-widget value.
